title: Uploading a Custom SSL Certificate for Zscaler Client Connector

blocks.text: Uploading your organization's custom SSL certificate is an optional step you can complete when configuring SSL inspection for Zscaler Client Connector.

When you upload your organization’s custom SSL certificate in the Zscaler Admin Console, and turn on the install Zscaler SSL Certificate option, the custom certificate is automatically installed on users’ devices.
The Install Zscaler SSL Certificate feature is not supported on devices running macOS Big Sur (11) and later.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Advanced Settings > Custom Root Cert.
On the Advanced Configuration tab, under Custom Certificate, click Upload.
